entries.title: Deductible allocation review
entries.objective: Verify whether the deductible allocation is supported and prepare an authorized next step.
requiredEvidence: Accumulator before this claim at the relevant adjudication point
Call reference if a call occurred
permittedProposals: Clarify with payer; draft reprocessing request (human authorization for external request)
Verify posting and crossover; stage secondary review
Review patient responsibility and protections (no automatic patient billing)
hardStops: Never infer family vs individual accumulators, embedded vs aggregate design, network allocation, reversal handling or timing from a single amount.
Do not normalize malformed or negative amounts into plausible values.
No patient responsibility conclusion without EOB/ERA.
Never assume a claim was not already forwarded to secondary.
Unknown secondary is not no coverage.
Do not bill full charge by default for out-of-network or multiple accumulators.

branches.condition: Claim identity or plan context unknown
Amounts malformed or negative outside a supported reversal case
branches.boundary: Do not normalize into plausible values

branches.condition: Allocation differs under verified supported-plan assumptions
branches.proposal: Clarify with payer; draft reprocessing request

branches.condition: Allocation consistent and secondary active at DOS
branches.proposal: Verify posting and crossover; stage secondary review
branches.boundary: Never assume claim was not already forwarded

branches.condition: Allocation consistent and no secondary found

branches.boundary: Do not bill full charge by default

entries.formula: expected deductible = min(allowed, max(0, deductible limit - amount met before this claim)), integer cents, supported simple plan only; not a universal adjudication formula.
callQuestions: Ask for claim status and processed date.
Capture allowed amount, actual deductible allocation and adjustment group.
Clarify plan year, accumulator and network tier used.
Ask how much had been met before this claim at adjudication, not today’s total; if unavailable mark unknown and request a written EOB.
If evidence supports an inconsistency, ask the representative to explain the allocation. Verbal reprocessing requests only if the client permits it.

Confirm whether the original was paid, denied or is pending, and for which lines.
